notes.title: Update - March 21st
notes.content:
• Added 3rd chance difficulty option
• Tunskull switches can’t be grabbed when in a bubble
• French saving message visual bug fixed
• Fixed bug where Captain Cat doesn’t say his pre-battle dialogue
• Added D-Pad support for retro enthusiasts (though mouse or Joystick are still the best way to play)
• Fixed bug where stars and missiles ignore post-hit invincibilityLevels slightly altered, improved + rebalanced
• Cheshire’s Ghost Ship difficulty improvements
• Turnskull Terrace difficulty improvements
• Deep Darkness level design improvements
• Buoy Basin difficulty improvements
• Whiplash Temple improvements
• Tree Trunk Climb difficulty improvements
• Minor improvements to space levels

notes.title: Update - March 16th
notes.content:
Change log:

[list]
[*] Honey Drip Hive fixed: Water item can now wash away honey as intended
[*] Swedish language (when selected at start of the game) now correctly switches to Swedish
[*] Soundblast Zone: speaker blasts sync up better
[*] Spicy Skyway: spike bug fixed
[*] vSync & FPS is dynamically set based on refresh rate, locking at 60fps, preventing physics bugs
[*] Some minor level / design fixes and difficulty improvements[/list]

notes.title: Pompom: the great space rescue is out now!
notes.content:
It is launch day!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/5d04f15bc1bfd22ed39a23e16ea16d321cbd675c.gif[/img]

Pompom can ride an unstoppable Mine Cart through a long series of mine rails, no needs to be a monkey for that !

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/278a38fa7a0227bc03be0000286ef7a18428eaa1.gif[/img]

You don't need to be an edgehog to have some fun and bounce on springs!

notes.content:
Discover 3 new tools to help Pompom make his way through obstacles:

Your path is blocked by weeds? Use your scissors to cut everything in your way!

notes.title: Help PomPom with hammers, balloons and mirrors!
notes.content:
Foresee PomPom's inevitable advance by helping him make it to the end of levels. But it won't be easy, as PomPom progress in the level you will need to use and avoid multiples items to help your favourite hamster.

Is something on your way? Break it with your hammer to free PomPom's path.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/84ae7673597dfb2cc42a1fe75cb27ba8074b429b.gif[/img]

Beach ballons look fun, but make sure it does not smash PomPom! 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/025468e84bfbc535bf424f067b22f5bf26ea07d8.gif[/img]

PomPom will also face tricky, yet useful mirrors in his adventures. Use them at your advantage to keep going forward!

Play & wishlist here:

notes.title: How did I create Pompom
notes.content:
I’m Willem, Pompom’s developer. Pompom is a project that grew out of the GMTK Jam in 2018 where it was ranked 13th out of more than a 1000 games. 

I’m a solo developer, and I created all of the art, code and design. 
The 90's was my favorite era for games. Back then, they were made with smaller teams in quicker time frames, with more experimentation, and less of a focus on modern game design concepts like “the game play loop” and more of a design ethos simply built around what was fun or interesting. These ideas drive my design.

I’m now polishing Pompom and creating it into a full-fledge, large-scale game with many worlds to explore, a plot with dastardly villains.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1717570/Pompom/

notes.title: Development stories stream
notes.content:
Join us on a stream where we share anecdotes and behind the scenes about the development of [b]Pompom: The Great Space Rescue[/b].

[b]About the Stream :[/b]

Stream will Start with Main Developer [b]Willem Rosenthal [/b]will host a stream of the game and talk about development stories on the Steam page of the game.

Then, [b]Bruno Leni[/b], the artist who made the in-game cutscene art and cover art plays and talks about his experience and inspirations working on the game’s cutscenes.

Finally, Lead Product Manager [b]Alexandre Lemieux[/b] will cast more casual gameplay and share his gamer feeling about the game vibe.
